name: Open Food — Dribbble-inspired UI/UX
purpose: Implementation-ready design guidance for redesigning Open Food's food discovery experience.

reference.inspection: Live desktop homepage, hero, search area and discovery grid inspected in browser.
observedPatterns: White canvas with generous horizontal gutters and whitespace
Horizontal navigation with a compact wordmark and pill primary action
Two-column hero with oversized dark heading and rounded media
Pill search field with circular accent submit button
Compact discovery tabs and outlined suggestion chips
Three-column image-led grid at the inspected desktop viewport
Rounded image containers with compact metadata beneath
reference.accuracy: sourceExtraction contains measured desktop computed styles from Dribbble homepage DOM. Other sections are proposed Open Food implementation specifications. This is a component-family extraction, not an export of every page, asset or interactive state on Dribbble.

direction.brand: Use Open Food's plate-and-fork logo and burnt-orange accent.
direction.hierarchy: Search first, product discovery second, subscription details contextual to nutrition access.
direction.imagery: Use actual product images returned by Open Food Facts. Keep packages fully visible with object-fit contain.
direction.contentRule: Use original Open Food copy and product imagery. Reference Dribbble's layout and interaction patterns.

typography.fontFamily: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

motion.reducedMotion: Disable transform animations and animated skeletons when prefers-reduced-motion is reduce.

header.alignment: logo left; navigation center; language and demo account right

smallScreenRules: Keep search visible before decorative media
Wrap recent-search chips without horizontal page overflow
Use full-width primary actions in dialogs

languageSelector.behavior: Preserve query and selected product when changing language; reload localized product data and interface copy.

hero.heading: Discover what's in your food.
hero.description: Search packaged foods by name or brand. Explore product information and unlock detailed nutrition.
hero.media: Optional original product arrangement; omit if suitable assets are unavailable.
hero.visibility: Full hero for initial state; compact title and search once results are displayed.

search.label: Search packaged foods
search.placeholder: Try a product or brand, such as Nutella
behavior: Submit with Enter or search button
Prevent blank submissions with inline guidance
Preserve query in URL for refresh and sharing
Show loading status without clearing the query

recentSearches.label: Recent searches
recentSearches.behavior: Deduplicate displayed terms; selecting a term submits it. Use stored recent searches from the backend.

resultsToolbar.right: Optional controls only when supported by the API
resultsToolbar.note: Do not add Dribbble's Shots/Designers/Services tabs or popularity sorting to food search without equivalent supported functionality.

productCard.container: Borderless on white; image region rounded with a soft neutral background.

image.fallback: Neutral package icon and Image unavailable text

metadata: Product name, up to two lines
productCard.interaction: Use a clear product-detail link; subtle image-background change on hover and visible focus outline. Keep required information available without hover.
avoid: Nested interactive elements inside a card link

productDetail.presentation: Dedicated page with back-to-results link preserving search context.
productDetail.layout: Product image left; name, brand and details right; stack on mobile.
productDetail.nutritionActive: Semantic table with nutrient name, value and unit; clearly label per-100g or per-serving basis from source data.

nutritionLocked.title: Unlock detailed nutrition
nutritionLocked.body: Subscribe to view this product's nutritional values.
nutritionLocked.style: Soft accent panel with lock icon and one primary action

productDetail.missingData: Display Not available for missing values. Never convert missing nutrition data into zero.

subscription.price: Read the configured monthly plan and currency; do not invent an amount.
subscription.verification: Show pending state after checkout return until backend confirms active access. Do not infer subscription activation solely from a redirect.
subscription.access: Backend enforces nutritional-data access. Do not send restricted values to free clients and hide them with CSS.

buttons.disabled: Keep label legible, prevent activation and show the reason where useful.

content: Product data from Open Food Facts
Language selector if not already readily accessible
footer.style: Small muted text, generous top spacing, subtle divider

clearSearch.appearance: Transparent circular control inside the search field
clearSearch.behavior: Clear input, return focus to input and reset results to initial state when committed; remove q consistently with existing routing.

accountSummary.layout: Avatar followed by two-line name/status block
accountSummary.name: Demo user
accountSummary.secondary: Localized renewal or membership date when supplied
accountSummary.mobile: Compact but preserve access to status and language controls.

pagination.layout: Centered Previous button, page label, Next button; 12px gap and 40px top margin
pagination.behavior: Update URL with existing page convention; keep query and locale; announce page change and move attention to results heading.
pagination.label: Page {page} of {totalPages}

backLink.behavior: Restore previous query and page from existing navigation context.

nutritionTable.caption: Nutritional values with explicit source basis
nutritionTable.semantics: Use table, caption, th with scope, and td.
nutritionTable.mobile: Allow labels to wrap; avoid page overflow.

statusBadge.active: Soft orange background with dark orange text

dialog.usage: Only if existing flows need a dialog

notification.layout: Icon, title, explanatory text and optional action
notification.behavior: Keep actionable failures visible; do not rely on a transient toast for checkout or search errors.

popover.behavior: Keyboard navigation appropriate to semantic control, outside click and Escape dismissal.

icons.behavior: Decorative icons aria-hidden; icon-only buttons have accessible names.

states.initial: Hero, search and existing recent searches; invite a first search without displaying fabricated products.
states.loading: Image-and-text skeleton cards matching final geometry; mark results aria-busy and announce Searching products.
states.success: Show query, available result count and product cards.
states.empty: No products found for this query. Suggest checking spelling or trying a brand; keep search available.
states.error: Explain that products could not be loaded and offer Retry while preserving query.
states.partial: Render available product fields with explicit fallbacks.
states.localeFallback: If selected-language product content is unavailable, show available source text and a short language-fallback note.
states.pagination: Use accessible pagination or Load more only if backend supports it; preserve loaded products on errors and announce added results.

requirements: Semantic header, nav, main and footer
Full keyboard operation and visible focus
Minimum 44px touch targets for primary controls
Text contrast at least 4.5:1 for normal text
Do not communicate status by color alone
Use a polite live region for search status
Use lang on the document and update with language selection
Restore focus after closing any dialog
Support 200% zoom and 320px viewport without page overflow

implementation.styling: Map tokens to CSS custom properties and Tailwind theme values. Reuse shared primitives for inputs, chips and buttons.
implementation.localization: Store interface copy in translation dictionaries for en, nl, de and fr; allow longer labels to wrap.
implementation.scope: This file specifies design only; it does not modify the application.
acceptanceChecks: Review initial, loading, results, empty and error states
Verify mobile, tablet and desktop layouts
Navigate search and product detail entirely with keyboard
Verify all four languages with long labels
Confirm missing images and nutrition fields remain readable
Confirm free and active subscription experiences
Verify restricted nutrition is withheld by the backend
Check search state survives refresh and back navigation
priority: Apply global tokens and shared controls
Restyle header and search across routes
Replace result-card geometry and metadata spacing
Apply shared typography and surfaces to product and nutrition screens
Verify all existing functionality and state coverage
implementation.fontNote: Mona Sans is the observed source font. The proposed Inter/system stack is a deliberate substitute; use an appropriately supplied font asset if matching typography exactly.
implementation.noUnsupportedControls: Do not add fake tabs, ratings, social actions or category filters. Retain their measured source styles as references only.

scope: Whole Open Food application: shared shell, discovery homepage, search results, product detail, nutrition access, subscription states and responsive shared components.

sourceExtraction.method: Read-only browser DOM inspection and screenshots

elements.name: announcementAction
elements.openFoodMapping: Compact secondary action; enlarge touch target

elements.name: heroTabs
elements.openFoodMapping: Optional segmented control when meaningful modes exist

elements.name: mediaControl
elements.openFoodMapping: Only if animated media is included

elements.name: discoveryTabs
elements.openFoodMapping: Optional only; food search currently has one mode

elements.name: suggestionChip
elements.openFoodMapping: Recent search chips with 44px hit area

elements.name: cardOverlay
elements.openFoodMapping: Optional detail affordance; essential action always visible

elements.name: cardOverlayActions
elements.openFoodMapping: Do not add unsupported like/save actions

elements.name: avatar
elements.openFoodMapping: Account avatar; source has multiple avatar sizes

elements.name: footerCategoryStrip
elements.openFoodMapping: Optional category discovery only if supported

observedElements: Labeled query input with nutella value
Back to search link on product page
targetInspection.note: Counts and account state are observations, not fixed application copy.

home.hero: Large Dribbble-inspired headline; search before optional media on mobile.

results.heading: Results for “{query}”
results.hero: Hide the large marketing hero when q is present.
results.urlState: Use existing page and locale parameter conventions; preserve q on refresh, pagination and back navigation.
results.count: Render returned count using locale-aware formatting, never a hardcoded 631.

product.desktop: Two-column image and details; nutrition below identity.
product.unknownProduct: Friendly not-found panel and back-to-search link.

subscriptionFree.presentation: Contextual nutrition panel or existing subscription screen

subscriptionActive.presentation: Header badge and unlocked nutrition panel

checkoutReturn.presentation: Existing return route or inline subscription panel
checkoutReturn.behavior: Preserve search context; poll only as appropriate for the existing backend flow; offer retry after failure.

button.loading: Stable width, progress indicator and busy label

input.invalid: Error border plus explanatory text linked with aria-describedby
